conventions.composite: a composite block's indicators covary with everything outside the block only through the composite: cov(x_block, y) = (R w) cov(C, y)
conventions.sigma: Sigma_std = L Phi L' + blockdiag(diag(1-lambda^2) for reflective, R-(Rw)(Rw)' for composite); Sigma_raw = D Sigma_std D, D = diag(sd)

classicPlsPopulationLimit.description: Population limit of classic PLS-SEM (Mode A for reflective, Mode B for composite blocks, no consistency correction) on standardised data; independent of the inner weighting scheme.
